rationale: finetuning.uk's playground page describes a chat with a fine-tuned model but has no chat (owner, 2026-09-03: 'the playground has no playground'; 'please sort out the tool'; decision the same day: BOTH a public demo and booked GPU hours). This is the public door for it: a third route group in tools-api, /api/v1/tools/playground/chat, that streams one reply from a self-hosted Ollama model as server-sent events. It copies the gripper's security shape exactly (CORS by deployed-site Origin, then the group's own body cap, then a per-IP httpguard band) and is opt-in like the gripper (mounted only when PLAYGROUND_OLLAMA_URL is set AND main passes the deps; a deployment not told about it serves exactly the routes it served before). It is stateless on purpose: the browser holds the transcript and sends it back, capped at 12 messages of 1000 runes. The model server is reached only from the island by URL; where that server lives (a small CPU VM; the in-cluster Ollama is NOT reachable from the island by design) is a deployment decision outside this change. No paid LLM API is in the path. Measured basis for the caps: the demo model on CPU does ~14 tok/s (2026-09-03), so num_predict defaults to 150 and the per-request timeout is 90 s; streaming exists because 150 tokens is ~11 s and a single JSON body would read as a stall. plan.summary: finetuning.uk's playground page has no playground: the owner decided (2026-09-03) on a public demo chat against a self-hosted open-weight model plus booked GPU hours. This change adds the public door only: a third, opt-in route group in tools-api, POST /api/v1/tools/playground/chat, mounted only when PLAYGROUND_OLLAMA_URL is set and main wires the deps, copying the gripper's security shape (CORS by deployed-site Origin -> the group's own body cap -> per-IP httpguard band). It validates a browser-held transcript (<=12 messages, <=1000 runes each, roles user/assistant, last from the user), calls Ollama /api/chat streaming with num_predict/num_ctx caps and a fixed system prompt, and relays tokens as server-sent events (token/done/error). Errors before the first token are JSON 400/503; after it, in-band. No paid LLM API is in the path; where the model server runs is a deployment decision outside this change (the island cannot reach the in-cluster Ollama by design). Round 2 adds: a router test proving the third group neither shares nor shadows the gripper's two groups; a stalled-stream deadline test; truncated:true on length-capped replies; and migration 737 for the island sites allowlist. Round 3: migration renamed with the _ISLAND sidecar suffix (the runner applied plain-named 198 to the core; measured), reuse of box/chat-service considered and ruled out with reasons, NewRouter callers enumerated. Round 4: mountBrowserGroup shared by gripper and playground; LANDMINES entry as an edit; aiservice's Ollama client checked (non-streaming); deployment topology measured (island only).
plan.risks: (1) CORS depends on the ISLAND's own sites table having finetuning.uk at status='deployed' — shipped as migration 737 (island target, hand-applied and ledgered like 198/276/436); until it is applied on the island every browser call 403s. (2) The model server URL is trusted config: a wrong URL yields 503s, never a leak, because nothing from the visitor reaches any other host. (3) Streaming commits status 200 before the reply is known; a mid-stream failure is reported as event: error, and the tests pin that. (4) The per-IP band (60/h, 300/d) is per-pod in-memory like the gripper's; the island runs one pod. (5) The system prompt is fixed English text in code; changing the demo's voice is a code change, which is deliberate (the demo is not LLM-voiced). Reviewer should check: the mount order matches mountGripper; no route is registered when either config or deps is absent; the body cap runs before any model call; num_predict is forwarded. Post-ship verification (island, not the cluster): docker exec island-tools-api-1 grep -ac '/api/v1/tools/playground' /proc/1/exe (>0) with a present control ('/api/v1/tools/gripper') and an absent control; then curl -H 'Origin: https://finetuning.uk' -X POST https://tools.apis.uk/api/v1/tools/playground/chat with a one-message body expecting 200 text/event-stream, and the same with Origin https://example.invalid expecting 403. Topology: tools-api has no workload in the cluster (kubectl census 2026-09-03 = 0); its only host is the island compose stack, and PLAYGROUND_OLLAMA_URL is not in /opt/island/.env, so nothing mounts until an operator sets it there. The mountBrowserGroup refactor touches the gripper's mount: the existing gripper route tests and TestGripperRequestsIsNotBehindCORS still pass unchanged, and TestPlaygroundDoesNotShareOrShadowTheGripperGroups exercises both tools mounted together.
